calendar.title: Vehicle-local calendar coverage
calendar.subtitle: Month and date fields use the vehicle IANA timezone, including DST boundaries.

support.title: Evidence support and fit eligibility
support.subtitle: Support describes the amount and breadth of evidence separately from the fitted seasonal magnitude.
support.gate: Fit status: {{status}} — {{reason}}. Eligibility requires at least 24 included samples, about 300 observed days, and 9 local calendar months by default.

curve.title: Fitted annual curve and residual band
curve.subtitle: A distance-weighted descriptive harmonic fit across local calendar day; the shaded band is the central residual range.
curve.chartSubtitle: Values are converted from canonical Wh/m at display time.
curve.aria: Fitted annual Wh per distance curve with a central residual band

monthProfile.title: Observed local-month profile
monthProfile.subtitle: Observed intensity and fitted month averages remain descriptive; month volume is shown alongside each point.
monthProfile.aria: Observed and fitted intensity by vehicle-local calendar month

timeline.title: Observed-vs-fitted timeline
timeline.subtitle: Rows are ordered by vehicle-local start date; dense histories are deterministically downsampled while retaining first and last observations.
timeline.aria: Observed, fitted, and deseasonalized energy intensity over the vehicle-local observation timeline

trendSection.title: Deseasonalized trend
trendSection.subtitle: Calendar harmonics are removed before the descriptive linear time term is shown; route and operating mix remain in the residual.
trendSection.aria: Deseasonalized energy intensity over the vehicle-local timeline

residual.title: Residual distribution
residual.subtitle: Residuals are observed intensity minus fitted intensity; the histogram shows each bin’s share of included distance, not an attributed cause.
residual.empty: No finite fitted residuals are available.
residual.aria: Histogram of included distance share by fitted residual bin

diagnostics.title: Model component diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Fit magnitude and evidence support are reported separately. R² is explicitly in-sample and descriptive.

monthSupport.title: Month support and distance profile
monthSupport.subtitle: Volume is evidence support, not a ranking of seasonal magnitude; distance uses the selected display unit.
monthSupport.empty: No included rows are available for month support.
monthSupport.aria: Included sample count and observed distance by vehicle-local calendar month

yearDirectory.title: Year-over-year directory
yearDirectory.subtitle: Local-calendar year summaries are descriptive and include sample volume and observed distance for context.
yearDirectory.empty: No local calendar years have included observations.

rankedMonths.title: Ranked local-month evidence
rankedMonths.subtitle: A descriptive ordering of observed month averages; support and distance remain visible so magnitude is not read without volume.
rankedMonths.empty: No local month has an included observation yet.

accounting.title: Returned-row accounting and recency
accounting.subtitle: Categories are mutually exclusive and reconcile exactly across the latest returned history window.
accounting.capWarning: Exactly the latest 1,000-row return window is represented; findings are not established lifetime history.

methodology.title: Methodology and interpretation limits
methodology.model: Six terms are fitted with distance weights: intercept, annual sine/cosine, semiannual sine/cosine, and a linear time term. Ridge regularization is sanitized before solving.
methodology.eligibility: A completed non-live drive needs valid local calendar fields, positive duration, at least the distance floor, finite positive energy, and plausible canonical Wh/m intensity.
methodology.scope: The result describes the returned latest history in {{timeZone}}. Weather, temperature, route mix, tyres, firmware, charging losses, and driving behavior are not modeled or attributed.
methodology.disclosure: R² is an in-sample descriptive fit statistic and is null for constant observations. Residual bands and support bands describe this returned sample only; they are not a promise about an unobserved interval.

brief.provenance: Returned vehicle history; descriptive local-calendar fit, not a forecast.
